name: ai-inventory
description: Scan a repository for the AI systems, model providers and oversight points it actually contains, review the manifest in a PR, and land it in Noru.

interface.shortDescription: Inventory the AI systems in this repository and land them in Noru.
interface.longDescription: Scans a repository for model and provider SDK usage, concrete model ids, agent and prompt definitions, retrieval sources, eval suites and human-oversight points, then produces a reviewable .noru/ai-inventory.yml. Every claim carries the file:line that produced it and a named owner. Pushes to Noru as assets, vendors and evidence with repository provenance.
capabilities: Model provider and retention claim provenance
EU AI Act and ISO 42001 classification suggestions
Idempotent push to Noru assets, vendors and evidence
interface.defaultPrompt: Scan this repository for AI systems and show me what would land in Noru.
